decision.rationale: The conjunction presents a high collision probability (Pc=0.0695) well above the operator's maneuver threshold (≥1e-4). Burn option O1 delivers a delta‑v of 0.1484 m/s, which satisfies both the operator policy max dv (0.5 m/s) and the mission constraint limiting a single burn to ≤0.5 m/s. Its lead time of 143.2 minutes provides ample time (>30 min) for command upload. The other object is debris incapable of maneuvering, so no coordination is required. O1 is a prograde (along‑track) burn, matching the mission‑allowed axes. All factors indicate a safe, compliant maneuver.
